resources.string: Open device settings
Timer settings changed
The device settings changed while you were editing. Refresh the channel and try again.
Request could not be completed
The Timer could not accept this request. Refresh the device and try again.
Check the program
One or more Timer settings are not supported. Review the channel program and try again.
Channel unavailable
This channel is no longer available on the device. Refresh the Timer before continuing.
Device is temporarily busy
The Timer does not currently have enough free resources to complete this change. Wait a moment and try again.
Output could not be controlled
The device could not confirm the requested output change. Check the connected equipment and try again.
Changes were not saved
The device restored the previous Timer settings because it could not save the changes. Your existing program remains active.
Timer requires a restart
The device locked Timer control after it could not safely restore the previous state. Restart the device before making more changes.
Timer data could not be verified
The device response did not match the supported Timer protocol. Reconnect and try again; check for a firmware update if this continues.
Timer request was rejected
The device could not complete the request. Refresh the Timer and try again.
Timer controls unavailable
This device or firmware version does not support these Timer controls.
Timer temporarily unavailable
The current Timer state could not be verified. Check the connection and try again.
Timer is offline
Reconnect the device, then try again.
Device time is not ready
Automatic programs will remain paused until the Timer receives a trusted local time. Manual channel control remains available.
